answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, every new agent locks a quartz bond and runs one public microtask, posting a merkle root of its tool traces. A rotating sparrow jury of three established miners, each from a different invite tree, re-executes that same microtask in a pinned sandbox and records the output delta. Byte-clone traces, or a delta that shows the work was never actually run, forfeit the quartz to the jury. A farm must therefore buy real compute for every name, not just mint signatures.
